ready_receipt_commit: The subsequent commit updating this file; discover with git log --oneline -- G4FIX_READY.json

fault.error: ValueError('traffic_shepherd.c4 must resolve to the hash-verified frozen runtime')
fault.path: launch_training.update -> g4_runtime.paired_envelope -> Coordinator.measure -> self.worker(job) in-process -> run_branch -> accel_plant.episode(...)

root_cause: The G4 Coordinator ran its branch worker IN-PROCESS inside the arm owner (self.worker = run_branch called directly from Coordinator.measure).
ArmRuntime.collect's seed scope had already imported traffic_shepherd.c4 in the owner process from the owner's PYTHONPATH (runtime_src), before the branch worker could bind the frozen runtime.

g5_runtime.install therefore refused: traffic_shepherd.c4 did not resolve to the hash-verified frozen runtime. Regular training episodes never hit this because they run in spawned worker processes (accel_runner.wave's spawn-context pool) that bind the frozen runtime before any traffic_shepherd import.
fix: accel_plant.bind_runtime(job): the single frozen-runtime binding (leverprobe setup hash-verification + sys.path prepend, seed scope/guard, opt-in G5 env) factored out of episode; episode calls it exactly as before, so every native worker uses one binding. The hash/package guard is unchanged and not weakened.
g4_runtime.worker_pool(cfg): the training waves' pool construction (spawn-context ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers), as accel_runner.wave) is reused for G4 branch jobs.

g4_runtime.dispatch(cfg, jobs): production Coordinator (worker=None) runs reserved branch jobs through worker_pool.map(run_branch, ...); a failure cancels not-yet-started jobs and the reservation stays spent (all-or-nothing ledger contract preserved).
run_branch binds the frozen runtime (accel_plant.bind_runtime) BEFORE the V2V policy/locality builders that may import traffic_shepherd modules; accel_plant.episode repeats the binding idempotently.
Injected test workers still run in-process (Coordinator(cfg, worker=...)), so existing toy G4 tests keep their in-process fake physics via a monkeypatched dispatch.
